# Clavis Encrypt 3.11.0

## 👋 Unlock with Windows Hello (free)

- Unlock your vault with your face, fingerprint or PIN instead of typing your password. Turn it on in **Settings → Windows Hello**.
- When you open Clavis, Windows Hello asks first; cancel it to type your password as usual. Your password always works.
- Your password is stored sealed with a key that only Windows Hello can recreate after you verify yourself, so the stored file alone doesn't reveal it.
- Changing your password turns it off until you turn it on again. It isn't offered for vaults that use a key file, so your second factor is never skipped.
- Needs a PIN, face or fingerprint set up in Windows (Settings → Accounts → Sign-in options).

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
